senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (मशति)
1 To sound.
2 To be angry or irascible.

m. (-शः)
1 Anger.
2 Sounding.
3 A musquito.
E.
मश to sound, &c., अच् aff.

r. 1st cl. (मषति)
To injure, to hurt or kill.

(इर, ई) इर् मसी r. 4th cl. (मस्यति)
1 To mete or measure by weight, bulk, length, &c.
2 To change form.

m. (-सः)
1 Measure.
2 Weight.
E.
मस to measure, aff. अच्.

m. (-षः)
1 A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
2 A jeweller's or goldsmith's weight, variously reckoned at five, eight, or ten Rattis, or seeds of the Abrus precatorius; the weight in common use, is about seventeen grains troy.
3 A blockhead, a fool.
4 A cutaneous disease.
E.
मष to hurt, aff. घञ्.

m. (-सः)
1 A month, the twelfth part of the Hindu year; it is usually a lunar one, consisting of thirty Tithis, but it may be a Saura or solar month, being equal to the sun's passage through a sign of the zodiac; there is also a Sāvana month, consisting of thirty risings and settings of the sun; a Nākṣatra month, or month regulated by the lunar asterisms, and a fifth description of month called Vārhaspatya, depending on the motions of the planet JUPITER; the lunar month also, being of two kinds, as reckoned from the new or from the full moon, completes six different modes of monthly computation.
2 A jeweller's weight: see माष.
E.
मास् the moon, aff. अण् or मस to measure, (the year by it,) aff. घञ्.

m. (-कः)
1 A gnat, a musquito.
2 A kind of cutaneous eruption, the formation of small pustules or warts.
3 A leather water bag.
E.
मश to be angry, and वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A gnat.
E.
मष to hurt, वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A weight of silver of two Rattis or about 4½ grains.
2 The same in gold.
3 A Māṣa: see the last.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-की)
The glomerous fig tree.
E.
मशक a gnat, and इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
A sort of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)

f. (-री)
Musquito curtains, bed curtains of gauze, or of any thin substance, used to keep off musquitoes.
E.
मश a musquito, हृ to take off, ट and ङीप् affs.

m. (-नः)
A dog.

f. (-षिः-षी)
1 Ink.
2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis.
E.
मष to hurt, इन् aff.; also मशि or मसि.

mf. (-सिः-सी)
1 Ink.
2 The stalk of the Nyctanthes tristis.
E.
मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. इन्; it also occurs, मशि, मशी, मषि, and मषी.

n. (-नं)
1 Hurting.
2 Measuring.
3 A medicinal fruit, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
E.
मष to hurt, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-नं)
A medicinal seed, (Serratula anthelmintica.)

m. (-रः)
An emerald.
E.
मस weight, ऋ to go or get, aff. अण्; also with कन् added मसारक; in some places it seems to be confounded with another gem of a blue colour, perhaps the sapphire.

m. (-रः)
The scum of boiled rice.
E.
मस to measure, aff. अरन्, and the vowel made long.

m. (-कः)
A snake's hole.
f. (-का)
1 A plant, (Nyctanthes tristis.)
2 Ink.
E.
मसि the stalk of the plant, &c., कन् added.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 Monthly, relating or belonging to a month.
2 Payable in a month, (a debt, &c.)
3 Hired by the month, (a servant.)
4 Lasting for a month.
5 Happening or occurring at the end of a month, what will occur a month hence, &c.
n. (-कं)
A particular Śrāddha, or obsequial sacrifice performed every day of new moon.
E.
मास a month, and ठक् or ठञ् aff.

f. (-पी)
An inkstand.
E.
मसि ink, कूपी a little well; also with कन् added मसिकूपिका.

nf. (-नं-नी)
An inkstand.
E.
मसि ink, and घान what holds or contains; also मशिधान, मषिधान, &c.

n. (-नं)
Alliance by the right of presenting the funeral meat balls to a deceased common progenitor (?)
E.
मस to measure, (affinity,) Uṇādi aff. इनन्.

f. (-ना)
Linseed, (Linum utilatissimum.)

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of a month, a month old.
E.
मास, and खञ् aff.

m. (-ण्यः)
A scribe, a clerk, an accountant.
E.
मसि ink, पण्य hireable.

m. (-थः)
A pen.
E.
मसि, and पथ path.

f. (-सूः)
An inkstand.
E.
मसि ink, प्रसू parent.

f. (-णिः)
An inkstand.
E.
मसि ink, and मणि a jewel.

n. (-नं)
Gum myrrh.
E.
मसि ink, वृद्ध to increase, aff. ल्युट्.

n. (-लं)
Writing ink.
E.
मसी ink, and जल water.

f. (-नी)
An inkstand.
E.
मसी ink, धानी what holds.

mf. (-रः-रा)
A sort of lentil or pulse, (Ervum hirsutum, or Cicer lens)
f. (-रा)
A whore.
E.
मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. उरच्; more usually मसूर.

mf. (-रः-रा)
A sort of pulse or lentil, (Ervum hirsutum, and Cicer lens)
f. (-रा)
A whore.
f. (-री)
1 Small-pox.
2 A small round pillow.
E.
मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. ऊरन्, मसूर, the pulse; the other meanings refer to this, implying resemblance to the pea in figure, &c.

m. (-कः)
A small round pillow.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-ला)
1 A black variety of the plant, commonly called Tëori, (Convolvulus turpethum.)
2 A twining shrub, (Echites frutescens.)
E.
मसूर pulse, विदल division; having a leaf like a split pea.

f. (-का)
1 A bawd, a procuress.
2 Small-pox.
E.
मसूरा a whore, aff. कन्, fem. form.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Smooth, soft, not hard, not rough.
2 Bland, mild, unctuous.
f. (-णा)
Linseed.
E.
मस to measure [] or weigh, aff. ऋण, form irr.; or सम equally, smoothly, ऋण to go or be, aff. क, and the initiatory letters irregularly transposed.

r. 1st cl. (मस्कते)
To go, to move: sometimes read मस्क.

m. (-रः)
A bambu.
E.
मस्क to go, aff. अर, or मकि to adorn, aff. अर, and the nasal rejected, with सुट् augment.

m. (-री)
1 The Brahman of the fourth and mendicant order.
2 The moon.
E.
मस्कर a bambu, (staff,) and इनि possess. aff.

(टु ओ) टुमस्जो r. 6th cl. (मज्जति)
1 To immerse, to sink or plunge in water.
2 To purify by washing or bathing.

n. (-स्तं)
The head: see the next.

mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The head, the skull.
2 The head or top of any thing.
E.
मस to weigh, aff. क्त, and कन् added.

m. (-हः)
The brain.
E.
मस्तक the head, and स्नेह marrow.

m. (-ख्यः)
The top of a tree.
E.
मस्तक the head, and आख्या appellation.

n. (-कं)
The neck, the upper part of it supporting the head.
E.
मस्तक the head, मूल the root, कन् added.

f. (-स्तिः)
Weighing, measuring.
E.
मस to weigh, क्तिन् aff.

m. (-स्कः)
The brain.
E.
मस्ति, मस्क to go or get, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.

n. (-स्तुः)
The watery part of curds, the whey.
E.
मस to weigh, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.

m. (-ङ्गः)
The brain; it also occurs मस्तुलुङ्गक.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Prohibitive, prohibiting, a prohibitor, a forbidder.
E.
मा particle of negation or prohibition, शब्द a sound, a word, and ठक् aff., implying the person or thing whence it proceeds.

f. (-र्णी)
A kind of leguminous shrub, (Glycine debilis.)
E.
माष the kidney bean, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष् resembling it in the leaf.

m. (-कः)
A goldsmith, a jeweller.
E.
माष the weight so called, and वृद्ध to increase, aff. वुन्.

ind.
Māṣa by Māṣa, (given away, &c.)
E.
माष a particular weight, and शसि aff. of successive order.

n. (-णं)
A field of kidney-beans.
E.
माष as above, खञ् aff.

n. (-ष्यं)
A field of kidney-beans.
E.
माष as above, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
Of or lasting a month, a month old.
E.
मास, and यत् aff.

m. (-माः)
1 The moon.
2 A month.
E.
मा splendor, light, अस् to be, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
A month old.
E.
मास, and जात born.

m. (-ज्ञः)
A gallinule.
E.
मास a month, and ज्ञ who knows.

m. (-तः)
New moon.
E.
मास, and प्रमित measured (by).

m. (-नः)
A year.
E.
मास a month, and मान measure.

f. (-का)
A kind of bird.
E.
मास a month, वृत to be, aff. वुन्.

m. (-न्तः)
Day of new moon.
E.
मास the month, and अन्त end.

f. (-री)
The beard.
E.
मस to measure, aff. उरन्, form irr.

ind.
A prohibitive particle.
E.
मा prohibitive, and स्म termination added.
